title: XPE AI model card (REQ-AI-010, REQ-AI-011)
description: What xpe_ai_get_model_card writes into the caller's buffer. Either the card of a model whose signature and sidecar passed (every field below is present; a field the sidecar does not carry is null, never a default), or the answer for a model_id no verified model has (returned with XPE_ERR_CONFIG_INVALID).

oneOf.title: the card of a verified model

model_version.description: REQ-AI-008 / REQ-AI-010. The sidecar's version, a semantic version 2.0.0.

intended_use.description: REQ-AI-010. null when the sidecar does not say.

training_data_summary.description: REQ-AI-010. null when the sidecar does not say.

demographic_performance.description: REQ-AI-010. null when the sidecar does not say.

limitations.description: REQ-AI-010. null when the sidecar does not say.

pccp_status.description: REQ-AI-010. The module has no authorized PCCP to compare pccp_scope with (T-011), so it writes not_evaluated; the other values are reserved for when it can judge.

published_date.description: REQ-AI-010. A date YYYY-MM-DD, or null when the sidecar does not say.

validation_metrics.description: REQ-AI-008. From the sidecar: a non-empty object.

oneOf.title: no verified model has this model_id
